extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed plan options with the customer, but the disclaimer was delivered after the benefits discussion, which is non-compliant. The agent also collected the Scope of Appointment and scheduled an appointment for 3 days later.
composition.coaching_note: Tamika should ensure the disclaimer is read before discussing any benefits to avoid non-compliance. Additionally, she should avoid collecting sensitive information like Medicare numbers and dates of birth during the call.

crm_record.next_step: Review and sign Scope of Appointment, plan review in 3 days
